He uses both rescue (albuterol) and maintenance (fluticasone/salmeterol) inhalers, indicating at least moderate COPD. Social factors include limited contact and involvement in risk activities, and he is employed full‑time. An opioid‑containing analgesic is prescribed without a documented pain diagnosis, raising concern for undocumented chronic pain. No recent visits after 1978 are recorded, and key labs (eGFR, lipids, BMI) are missing.
